episodes.title: It's About Time
episodes.summary: When Mark Grayson finally inherits powers from his superhero father, it's a dream come true. But there's more to being a hero than just choosing a name and costume.

episodes.title: Here Goes Nothing
episodes.summary: With his father out of action, Mark struggles to defend the city against an interdimensional invasion, joining forces with a team of teenage superheroes.

episodes.title: Who You Calling Ugly?
episodes.summary: Mark has to cut a study date short to help save Mount Rushmore from a crazed scientist. Robot deals with Action - Comic as he assembles a new team of world-saving superheroes.

episodes.title: Neil Armstrong, Eat Your Heart Out
episodes.summary: It's two firsts for Mark: a first date and a first trip to another planet. At the same time, Nolan and Debbie revisit their own first vacation together.

episodes.title: That Actually Hurt
episodes.summary: Feeling confident in his new abilities, Mark risks a team-up with a local villain to take down a crime lord, while simultaneously juggling school and a new relationship.

episodes.title: You Look Kinda Dead
episodes.summary: Mark joins William and Amber on a campus visit to Upstate University, hoping to discover a new future for himself. Debbie makes her own disturbing discovery.

episodes.title: We Need to Talk
episodes.summary: Feeling lost and confused, Mark looks for advice from Eve. At the same time, everyone's looking for him.

episodes.title: Where I Really Come From
episodes.summary: Mark must prove he's become the hero he's always wanted to be by stopping an unstoppable force.

episodes.title: A Lesson for Your Next Life
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of his father's betrayal, Mark struggles with his responsibilities as Invincible and encounters an unexpected enemy.

episodes.title: In About Six Hours I Lose My Virginity to a Fish
episodes.summary: It's summer break for Mark and his friends, but supervillains don't take a vacation. Mark is forced to face the consequences of Omni-Man's double life.

episodes.title: This Missive, This Machination
episodes.summary: Mark starts his college career, Debbie struggles with personal trauma, and Allen the Alien returns home to find a new threat facing the Coalition of Planets.

episodes.title: It's Been a While
episodes.summary: Mark answers the call to save an alien species, but the mission has unexpected personal consequences.

episodes.title: This Must Come as a Shock
episodes.summary: The Grayson household is upended when Mark returns to Earth with surprising new responsibilities. The Guardians of the Globe face dangers both at home and away.

episodes.title: It's Not That Simple
episodes.summary: After two challenging missions, The Guardians of the Globe struggle to work as a team. Meanwhile, Mark tries to balance his hero duties, personal relationships, and his future as a college student.

episodes.title: I'm Not Going Anywhere
episodes.summary: As Mark attempts to salvage his personal life, a new villain arrives, presenting Invincible with his greatest challenge yet. Donald grapples with his past.

episodes.title: I Thought You Were Stronger
episodes.summary: An old enemy threatens everything Mark holds dear.

episodes.title: You're Not Laughing Now
episodes.summary: Mark Grayson is back and stronger than ever - with new enemies out for blood and old villains out for revenge.

episodes.title: A Deal with the Devil
episodes.summary: Mark takes a stand, unaware of the ramifications for his family, the GDA, and even the Guardians. Cecil remembers his past and Eve makes an important decision.

episodes.title: You Want a Real Costume, Right?
episodes.summary: Mark struggles to teach Oliver what it means to be a superhero. Debbie explores a new relationship and a changed family dynamic.

episodes.title: You Were My Hero
episodes.summary: Two strangers ask Mark for help with a mysterious villain. Elsewhere in the galaxy, Nolan grapples with his identity and Allen finds a surprising new ally.

episodes.title: This Was Supposed to Be Easy
episodes.summary: Mark and Eve start a business and encounter a familiar face. Debbie worries that Oliver's growing up too quickly.

episodes.title: All I Can Say Is I'm Sorry
episodes.summary: A powerful new figure challenges Mark's idea of what's right and what's wrong. Rae approaches Rex with a big life decision.

episodes.title: What Have I Done?
episodes.summary: Earth's greatest heroes join forces to fight an unimaginable threat.

episodes.title: I Thought You'd Never Shut Up
episodes.summary: With the world still reeling, a dangerous stranger arrives - testing Mark to his limits and beyond.

episodes.title: Making the World a Better Place
episodes.summary: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.

episodes.title: I'll Give You the Grand Tour
episodes.summary: Loyalties are challenged when an old enemy is revealed.

episodes.title: I Gotta Get Some Air
episodes.summary: Consequences weigh on Mark. Oliver takes on a new job.

episodes.title: Hurm
episodes.summary: Hurm.

episodes.title: Give Us a Moment
episodes.summary: Mark embarks on a new and dangerous mission, throwing Debbie into a tailspin and plunging Eve into uncertainty.

episodes.title: You Look Horrible
episodes.summary: Family bonds are put to the test. Under pressure, Allen makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Don't Do Anything Rash
episodes.summary: Nothing goes according to plan during a massive confrontation.

episodes.title: Don't Leave Me Hanging Here
episodes.summary: Mark confronts his darkest fears as his life changes forever.
